title: English Practice Quiz 0810
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Business and Financial Basics 01: Cash flow describes:
options: Money moving into and out of an organisation
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Money moving into and out of an organisation. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business and Financial Basics 02: A balance sheet reports:
options: Assets, liabilities and equity at a point in time
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Assets, liabilities and equity at a point in time. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business and Financial Basics 03: An operating expense is:
options: A cost incurred in day-to-day business operations
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: A cost incurred in day-to-day business operations. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business and Financial Basics 04: Gross profit is calculated as:
options: Revenue minus cost of goods sold
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Revenue minus cost of goods sold. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business and Financial Basics 05: A financial forecast is:
options: An estimate of future results based on assumptions
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: An estimate of future results based on assumptions. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business and Financial Basics 06: A credit note is commonly issued to:
options: Reduce or adjust an amount previously invoiced
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Reduce or adjust an amount previously invoiced. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business and Financial Basics 07: An asset is:
options: A resource controlled by an organisation with economic value
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: A resource controlled by an organisation with economic value. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business and Financial Basics 08: A liability is:
options: An obligation the organisation is required to settle
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: An obligation the organisation is required to settle. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business and Financial Basics 09: A break-even point occurs when:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Total revenue equals total costs. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business and Financial Basics 10: Variance analysis is used to:
options: Understand differences between planned and actual results
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Understand differences between planned and actual results. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.
